```{ojs prelims}
//| output: false

Plot = import("https://esm.sh/@observablehq/plot@0.6.17")

// defined in _load-data-items.qmd
items = transpose(items_)
models = transpose(models_)

// create combined item_group and language, sort by task
task_order = ([ "hf", "sds", "mg", "math", "matrix", "mrot", "trog", "vocab", "tom", "pa", "sre", "swr" ])
items_coded = items
  .map(d => ({...d, lang_group_label: `${d.item_group_label} | ${d.language}` }))
  .sort((a, b) => {
    return task_order.indexOf(a.task_code) - task_order.indexOf(b.task_code)
  })

// group items by task for task selector
tasks = d3.group(items_coded, d => d.task_label)
```

::: {.column-screen-inset}

::: {.callout-note .tab-note appearance="simple"}
::: {.info-text}
{{< bi info-circle class=header-icon >}}This Items tab shows estimated difficulty by item group. Item groups are clusters of items defined _a priori_ based on conceptual similarity, and were not used to estimate the scores themselves.
:::
:::

```{ojs task}
viewof task_items = url_bound("task", Inputs.select(tasks, { label: "Task", value: tasks.get("Math") }), { choices: tasks })
```

```{ojs data-prep}
//| output: false

// channels for item tooltips
item_vars = ["item_group_label", "item_uid", "n_responses", "guessing"]
item_channels = Object.fromEntries(item_vars.map(k => [k, k]))

task = task_items[0].task_code // current items' task code
model = models.filter(t => t.task_code === task)[0] // current items' model type
by_lang = model.language !== undefined // whether items' model is by language

// sort order of languages -- alpha
langs = d3.sort(new Set(task_items.map(d => d.language)))
// sort order of item groups -- median difficulty (in first language)
l0_items = task_items.filter(d => d.language === langs[0])
groups = d3.groupSort(l0_items, g => d3.median(g, d => d.difficulty), d => d.item_group_label)
// sort order of language + item group -- above combined
indeces = d3.groups(task_items, d => d.lang_group_label)
            .map(([lang_group_label, vals]) =>
                    [lang_group_label, langs.indexOf(vals[0].language), groups.indexOf(vals[0].item_group_label)])
lang_groups = d3.sort(indeces, d => d[1], d => d[2]).map(d => d[0])
```

```{ojs plot-config}
//| output: false

// plot height in pixels for each task
heights = ({
  "hf":     180,
  "sds":    240,
  "mg":     220,
  "math":   490,
  "matrix": 220,
  "mrot":   150,
  "trog":   690,
  "vocab":  340,
  "tom":    300,
  "pa":     320,
  "swr":    600
})

// shared options for both parameter plots
item_opts = ({
         style: { fontFamily: "var(--sans-serif)", fontSize: 12, overflow: "visible" },
         width: 800,
        height: heights[task],
    marginLeft: 200,
     marginTop: 50,
  marginBottom: 40,
          grid: true,
         facet: { label: null, grid: true },
             x: { line: true },
             r: { range: [1, 4] },
            fy: { domain: by_lang ? lang_groups : groups },
         color: { domain: groups.length > 1 ? groups : langs, legend: false, scheme: "viridis" },
})

// dot mark for each plot, depending on x variable
item_dots = (x_var) => {
  return Plot.marks(
    Plot.dot(task_items, Plot.dodgeY("middle", {
      x: x_var,
      fy: by_lang ? "lang_group_label" : "item_group_label",
      fill: groups.length > 1 ? "item_group_label" : "language",
      r: "n_responses",
      tip: { format: { fy: false } }, //, anchor: "left"
      channels: item_channels
    }))
  )
}
```

```{ojs plot-difficulty}
// item difficulties plot
plot_d = Plot.plot({
  ...item_opts,
  marks: item_dots("difficulty")
})

// item discriminations plot -- hide if model isn't 2PL
plot_a = model.itemtype !== "2PL" ? html`<div></div>` :
Plot.plot({
  ...item_opts,
  marks: item_dots("discrimination")
})
```

```{ojs plot-icc}
// item characteristic curve plot
Plot.plot({
  style: { fontFamily: "var(--sans-serif)", fontSize: 12, overflow: "visible" },
  className: "icc-plot",
  width: 250,
  height: 250,
  marginBottom: 40,
  x: {
    line: true,
    label: "ability",
    domain: [theta_min, theta_max],
    ticks: d3.range(theta_min, theta_max, 2.5).concat(theta_max)
  },
  y: {
    line: true,
    label: "probability correct",
    domain: [0, 1],
    ticks: d3.range(0, 1, 0.25).concat(1)
  },
  color: plot_d.scale("color"), // use color scale from difficulty plot
  subtitle: item ? item_label(item) : "",
  marks: [
    Plot.ruleY([item?.guessing || null], {
      stroke: "lightgrey",
      strokeDasharray: "4 3",
      strokeLinecap: "round"
    }),
    Plot.line(item_icc, {
      x: "theta",
      y: "p",
      stroke: groups.length > 1 ? "item_group_label" : "language"
    })
  ]
})

// label item with item_uid, add language in parentheses if defined
item_label = (item) => item.language ? `${item.item_uid} (${item.language})`: item.item_uid
```

::::

```{ojs}
//| output: false

// IRF (item response function)
// theta = ability, a = discrimination, b = difficulty, c = lower bound
irf = (theta, a, b, c) => c + (1 - c) / (1 + Math.exp(-a * (theta - b)))

// theta array
theta_min = -5
theta_max = 5
thetas = d3.range(theta_min, theta_max, 0.01)

// ICC (item characteristic curve)
icc = (thetas, a, b, c) => thetas.map(t => ({theta: t, p: irf(t, a, b, c)}))
icc_item = (thetas, item) => icc(thetas, item.discrimination, item.difficulty, item.guessing)

// instantiate item object and its ICC array
mutable item = null
item_icc = item ? icc_item(thetas, item).map(d => ({...d, ...item})) : []

// find selected item in item data -- match by item_uid, then by language if defined
match_item = (vals) => vals ? task_items.filter(d => d.item_uid === vals.item_uid && (d.language === undefined || d.language === vals.language))[0] : null

// add event listeners to parameter plots that set item object based on hovered point
plot_d.addEventListener("input", (event) => mutable item = match_item(plot_d.value))
plot_a.addEventListener("input", (event) => mutable item = match_item(plot_a.value))
```

:::
